name: YT6

chatHistory.content:
Create a 38-second b-roll animation at 4K (3840x2160), 25fps. This will be overlayed on top of a voiceover, so there is no audio needed.

Background: near-black (#0A0A0A) throughout. All text: Inter Semibold. Primary accent: #00B3E3. Red accent: #EF4444. Dark grey: #2A2A2A. Text: white (#FFFFFF).

The core visual motif is a thin horizontal progress bar (4px tall, rounded ends). This single shape evolves across all scenes to tell a continuous story: content overload, missed signals, spreading damage, and then a system that filters signal from noise.

SCENE 1 (0:00 - 0:03.22): A single progress bar appears center screen, 600px wide, filling left to right. Before it completes, another spawns 12px below. Then another. They accelerate, spawning 10-15 per second by the 2s mark, filling the screen vertically from center outward. By scene end, roughly 120-150 bars fill the screen, all animating at different speeds. Dense, rhythmic, hypnotic.

SCENE 2 (0:04.07 - 0:11.03): All bars freeze and fade to dark grey (#1A1A1A). One bar near center turns #00B3E3, resumes filling to 100%. A small label fades in beside it: "50K views" (18px, white). Everything else stays frozen and dark.

SCENE 3 (0:11.13 - 0:18.03): The blue bar glows outward (soft radial, cyan shifting toward warm white, 1.5s expand). Then reverses: glow contracts, bar fades from #00B3E3 to #2A2A2A over 3 seconds. It becomes indistinguishable from the other grey bars. The opportunity disappeared back into the noise.

SCENE 4 (0:18.03 - 0:24.20): A different bar in the lower-left area turns #EF4444. Red spreads to neighboring bars outward, accelerating. Each bar transitions grey to red over 0.2s. By scene end, roughly 60% of bars are red and still spreading. Hard cut at the end.

SCENE 5 (0:24.20 - 0:29.23): Hard cut to empty black. 0.3s pause. A single 2px line (#00B3E3) draws left to right across center screen over 1.2s. "YouTube Scraper" (72px, white) fades in above. "by Apify" (32px, #00B3E3) fades in below. The line pulses once.

SCENE 6 (0:29.23 - 0:38.01): Title text slides up and shrinks to top of frame. Blue line stays centered. Small grey bars (200px wide) stream in from the left at varied vertical positions, 2-3 per second. Most pass through the blue line and fade off right. Some (roughly 30%) flash white at the line, turn #00B3E3, and snap into a neat vertical stack on the right side. First caught bar gets a label: "mention." Second: "creator." Third: "data point." Bars keep streaming. Stack keeps growing. Hold final frame 1 second.

scriptWithTimestamps:
00:00:00:01 - 00:00:03:22
YouTube has over 500 hours of video uploaded every minute.
00:00:04:07 - 00:00:07:06
Somewhere in there, a creator just featured your product
00:00:07:06 - 00:00:11:03

and by the time you find it manually, it might already have 50,000 views.

00:00:11:13 - 00:00:15:00
That review could be glowing - and you missed the window to share it,
00:00:15:09 - 00:00:18:03
amplify it, or reach out to that creator.
00:00:18:03 - 00:00:21:23
Or it could be critical - and it's already shaping how thousands of people
00:00:21:23 - 00:00:24:20
think about your brand, while you're still in the dark.
00:00:24:20 - 00:00:26:02
Today I'm going to show you
00:00:26:02 - 00:00:29:23
how to use YouTube Scraper from Apify to build a fully automated brand
00:00:29:23 - 00:00:32:23
monitoring system that catches every mention,
00:00:32:23 - 00:00:36:06
surfaces influencer opportunities, and feeds your data
